items.title: Capital One (COF) Stock Looks Below Fair Value Despite A 102% Run
items.summary: Capital One Financial has more than doubled shareholders' money over the past three years, yet its current valuation checks still point to the stock trading at a discount to an internally estimated intrinsic value. With fresh legal headlines in the background, the question for investors is whether that apparent discount is a genuine opportunity or compensation for higher perceived risk. items.title: Why Capital One says it really closed more than 300 of Trump’s accounts
items.summary: A new court filing says months of anti-money-laundering analysis—not political pressure—led to the closure of hundreds of the Trump Organization’s accounts.

items.title: Trump’s Capital One accounts closed after AML review, bank says
items.summary: The bank has not accused the Trump Organization of money laundering. But Capital One said the transaction patterns it identified are “among the types of activity flagged by federal banking guidance.”

items.title: Capital One says it shut down hundreds of Trump Organization accounts over money-laundering concerns
items.summary: Capital One closed hundreds of Trump Organization accounts in 2021 “for anti-money laundering reasons,” the bank disclosed for the first time in a court filing Friday night.
